research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free review of shared mathematical prerequisites with original context and non-merge restrictions.

aliases.reason: The fibred-setoid and fibred-set 2-category formulations both define 2-morphisms as natural transformations of over-base functors whose components lie over identity arrows in C. Whether a fibre is a setoid or discrete is a distinct parent constraint.

Integral-element and integral-ring-map formulations use a monic polynomial to test vanishing at an element; standard étale maps and minimal polynomials also use the leading-coefficient-one predicate. The common prerequisite is being monic; satisfaction of a monic equation or étaleness is not identified.

Orthogonal-polynomial integrals over (a,b) and antiderivatives on open real interval I both invoke an open connected real interval as domain. Bounded and unbounded endpoint choices specialize that concept; orthogonality and differentiability remain separate.

Both independent smooth-ring-map formulations invoke chain-complex quasi-isomorphism: a chain map inducing homology isomorphisms or a zigzag in derived comparisons. Finite projectivity of the comparison module and the cotangent-complex construction are parent-level conditions.

The two affine-hull variants invoke exactly finite affine combinations ∑α_i x_i with real scalar coefficients summing to one, without nonnegativity. The hull's intersection-of-affine-closed-sets versus generating-set presentation are distinct equivalent parent formulations and should not be conflated with convex combinations.
